# Data Source: catalyst_auth_users

Read one page of access metadata for existing Catalyst application users. Requires `ZohoCatalyst.projects.users.READ`. Email addresses, personal names, and profile details are omitted. Use the exact-ID data source for a specific known user. Verified offline.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    catalyst = {
      source = "edson-edwin/catalyst"
    }
  }
}

data "catalyst_auth_users" "first_page" {
  project_id = "123456789"
  start      = 0
  limit      = 50
}

output "user_ids" {
  value = data.catalyst_auth_users.first_page.users[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Existing Catalyst project's positive numeric ID as a string.

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Page size from 1 through 200. Defaults to 50.
- `start` (Number) Zero-based offset. Defaults to 0.

## Attribute Reference

- `users` (Attributes List) This page's users sorted lexicographically by ID. A successful empty page returns an empty list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Application user ID as a precision-preserving string.
- `role_id` (String) Assigned role ID, when reported.
- `role_name` (String) Assigned role name, when reported.
- `status` (String) Application account status, when reported.
- `user_type` (String) Application account type, when reported.
